title: Call: State Epidemiologist Duty Line — Definition, Count, Couriers

caller.name: State Epidemiologist on Duty
caller.label: Iowa HHS, State Epidemiology Duty Line

transcript.speaker: State Epi
transcript.text: Morning, this is the state epidemiologist on duty at Iowa HHS, returning your page. Got your message about the Heritage Days supper. Before I log it, I need a few things from you.

transcript.speaker: State Epi
transcript.text: First, what's your working case definition? Person, place, time, clinical. Even a draft is fine, I just need to know what you're counting.

transcript.speaker: State Epi
transcript.text: Okay. Second, your count by tier, with an as-of time. And your earliest and latest onset, by onset, not by when they showed up at the ED.

transcript.speaker: State Epi
transcript.text: Got it. Heads-up on specimens. The State Hygienic Lab courier only runs Tuesday through Friday. If you want stools or that leftover food picked up today, your Director has to authorize a special courier. Otherwise everything waits for tomorrow's run.

transcript.speaker: State Epi
transcript.text: Also, how many Cary-Blair kits do you have on hand right now? If you've got four hundred people who ate that meal, you'll want more than a shelf's worth.

transcript.speaker: State Epi
transcript.text: Last one. Have you put the definition out to MRMC, the urgent cares and the school nurses yet? I'd like to know when that alert goes out so our numbers line up with yours.

transcript.speaker: State Epi
transcript.text: Alright. Send me the draft definition and that count by email when you have them, and call me back when the Director decides on the courier.

voiceStyles.State Epi: Calm, experienced epidemiologist in his 50s, brisk and methodical, quiet office behind him
voiceStyles.MCHD Epi: Local epidemiologist answering the desk line, professional

instructorNote: Pause at each prompt turn so EPI can answer live. Look for a count by tier with an as-of time (for example 11 suspect as of 09:30, 7 linked to the supper) and an onset range of 02:00 Sun to 03:00 Mon, which is 6.5 to 9 hours after a 17:00–19:30 meal. Also look for a draft three-tier definition sent to DIR for approval within the 8-hour target, a Cary-Blair kit count from NM along with the fax and email alert, and a trigger from DIR for when to authorize a special courier today.
